skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK (+10) DMG to a single target, and enters [Berserk] for 1 turn (DMG increased by 30%).

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 5 hit combo of 30% ATK (+2) DMG to each enemy in the entire column, with a 100% chance to inflict [Internal Injury] on struck targets (when hit, adds Internal Injury DMG equal to 140% ATK of Silver Fang; effect is removed after triggering).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 5 hit combo of 38% ATK (+2) DMG to each enemy in the entire column, with a 100% chance to inflict [Internal Injury] on struck targets (when hit, adds Internal Injury DMG equal to 160% ATK of Silver Fang; effect is removed after triggering).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). At the start of battle, grants the whole team 30% Block rate for 2 turns. After an ally character triggers Block, they gain [Tenacity] (absorbs DMG equal to 7% of their own HP, up to 3 times per turn).

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). At the start of battle, grants the whole team 30% Block rate for 2 turns. After an ally character triggers Block, they gain [Tenacity] (absorbs DMG equal to 8% of their own HP, up to 4 times per turn).

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). At the start of battle, grants the whole team 30% Block rate for 2 turns. After an ally character triggers Block, they gain [Tenacity] (absorbs DMG equal to 8.5% of their own HP, up to 4 times per turn).

effects.desc: The shield absorbs damage over time and damage types (Damage, Internal Damage, Charge).
Damage over time based on ST, disappears after activation; Can Detonate to explode.
